cs.t: I also didn't like concerts for 20 years because they were way too loud. I would take cheap foam earplugs for mowing the lawn and all you could hear/fell was bass. Then I got some Etymotic high fidelity earplugs and concerts are enjoyable.  They reduce all frequencies equally so the music still sounds good.
cs.th: The Best Place to Drink Is the Emptiest Bar in the City
